archetype: Organic & Earthy (Trust, Growth, Calm) optimized for High-Density Civic Operations

rules: Avoid standard 'Bootstrap' text centering; align left for readability.
Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large headers.
Use font-black or font-extrabold for prominent numbers in the admin dashboard.
Use primary color minimally for CTAs, active states, and focus rings.
Never use pure black (#000000); use the tinted text.primary (#1A2E1A) for dark text.
Never use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays or dropdowns.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces preferred. Do not use Glassmorphism in data-heavy Admin dashboards to prevent visual refraction of data.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use crisp 1px borders (border-slate-200 or border-muted) to define cards rather than relying heavily on shadow.

radius.buttons: rounded-full (pill-shaped) for public, rounded-md for admin
radius.cards: rounded-xl for public pages, rounded-lg for admin panels

public_page.style: The 'Tetris' Grid for featured content, overlapping elements for hero.
public_page.spacing: Generous spacing. py-16 to py-24 for sections. gap-8 to gap-12.

dashboard.style: High Density Grid for Analytics and Data. Every pixel must be utilized.
dashboard.spacing: Tight spacing. p-4 to p-6. gap-4 or gap-6.
dashboard.structure: Sidebar navigation (collapsible on mobile) + Topbar with prominent 'Buletin' button linking to public page.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for public CTAs, rounded-md for dashboard actions. Explicit hover and active states.
components.cards: Public: padded generously (p-6), subtle ambient shadow. Admin: flat, 1px border, compact (p-4).
components.badges: Status badges (Baru/Dibaca/Selesai) must use rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold with status-specific colors.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form/Input components heavily customized. Inputs should have muted background, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary. Support file uploads.
components.navigation: Public: Sticky header with solid background. Include 'Dashboard' button for Admins. Admin: Left sidebar for desktop, bottom tab or hamburger for mobile.
components.tabs: Use Shadcn Tabs for navigating between 'Form', 'Laporan Warga', and 'Laporan Saya'.

rules: Add transition-all duration-200 for hover states to all interactive elements.
Stagger entrance animations for list items in Laporan Warga.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets at least 4.5:1 APCA/WCAG ratio against backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Apply focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2 on all inputs and buttons.
accessibility.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-report-btn', data-testid='nav-buletin').

hero_background.description: Group of people talking, representing community engagement. Use in public hero section with max opacity bg-black/40 or gradient overlay to ensure text contrast.

mobile_app_feature.description: Person using a smartphone outdoors. Use for 'akses dari mobile' visual context.

rules: Do not use placeholder text or dummy images. Use the provided URLs.
Hero images must not be entirely hidden by dark overlays. Use bg-black/30 or gradient overlay.
Images should not exceed 80vh on mobile.

3d_and_creative.strategy: Minimal. This is a civic platform requiring high legibility and operational clarity. Use Recharts for dashboard statistics, avoiding heavy 3D libraries to keep performance snappy.

setup: Initialize Tailwind and ensure colors are mapped in tailwind.config.js as CSS variables.
Install required fonts from Google Fonts: Manrope and Work Sans.
structure: Build a hybrid_fullstack layout. Include Public Pages and Admin Dashboard.
Public Pages: Login, Form Pengaduan & Aspirasi (with attachment, anonim/rahasia checkboxes), Laporan Warga (bulletin list with badges), Laporan Saya.
Admin Pages: Dashboard (Statistik), Master Data CRUD (RW, RT, Warga, Pengurus, Kategori), Role & Permission, Pengaduan/Aspirasi Moderation.
Top-right 'Buletin' button in Admin must route to Public Home.
Top-right 'Dashboard' button in Public must route to Admin Dashboard.
components_to_use: Shadcn Tabs for Public reporting navigation.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions (e.g. transition-colors).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Missing categories for images means use provided images, NEVER use placeholder text.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid for E2E tests.
